metric.why: Distributed AI training is unusually intolerant of network degradation; a lossy fabric shows up as wasted GPU-hours before it shows up as an outage.
metric.metric: Network latency, packet loss, and bandwidth
metric.definition: Continuous measurement of round-trip latency, loss rate, and utilization on the facility's internal fabric and external transit.

reading.body:
For distributed AI training, network latency, packet loss, and bandwidth are measured as uptime metrics because a lossy fabric wastes GPU-hours before it causes an outage.

The metric sits in the uptime and redundancy category alongside UPS battery health and SLA compliance. That placement treats the internal fabric and external transit as reliability infrastructure, not just performance plumbing. In AI data centers, degraded network conditions can waste GPU-hours even when every server stays powered and nominally online.

The data does not specify acceptable thresholds for latency, loss, or utilization, nor does it quantify how many GPU-hours are lost to a given level of degradation. It also does not distinguish between internal fabric and external transit in the reported measurements, so the reader cannot tell which segment is the binding constraint.
